item.title: Global summit calls for 'secure, trustworthy and robust AI'
item.description: Global summit calls for 'secure, trustworthy and robust AI' Siya Tsewu Sat, 02/21/2026 - 18:05 NEW DELHI - Dozens of nations including the United States and China called for "secure, trustworthy and robust" artificial intelligence, in a declaration issued Saturday after a major summit on the technology in New Delhi.The statement signed by 86 countries did not include concrete commitments to regulate the fast-developing technology, instead highlighting several voluntary, non-binding initiatives."
